subject: ORDER VB-RUN14 R6.3: wave 4 run 3 target selection from the content reading, week-major, through week 26
method: every open in-scope cell with ruled week <= 26 (Art excluded; Science weeks 1-2 excluded) was scored SERVES against every lesson surface in its lane and subject, using the same tokeniser, stemmer, stopword and corpus-ubiquity rules as cell_coverage.py. A cell where no lesson reaches 0.85 is a true gap; a cell where an untraced lesson reaches 0.85 is proxy-served and is not a build target (7 of 9 refuted); a cell with under three distinctive words is unscorable.

untracedNotUnserved.reading: the earliest true gaps by week are ASDAN cells whose week-1 strand decks exist, are named for the cell, and carry no trace (spine MEASUREMENT INVALID), so the SERVES proxy under-scores them. Building a second week-1 deck would duplicate a live lesson. Recorded for a ruling: a trace row on the live deck, which is a change to a VERIFIED surface and is not made inside this order.
